$schema: play-store-apps example — copy to play-store-apps.json and tick what you install on the TEST phone

apps.note: Artemis and the agent use this to open sites on the phone
play / search videos (e.g. Artemis demo flows)
read/send mail only with your approval, on the test account
open documents and sheets from Drive
view screenshots the agent takes on the phone
read test SMS / OTPs only on the test device, with your approval

comment: You install these YOURSELF, once, from the Play Store on the dedicated test Android phone, signed in with the dedicated test Gmail account you created manually. Artemis then drives the phone and can open the apps you installed. Nothing here installs or updates an app for you, and nothing bypasses Play Store verification: app updates come from the Play Store's own auto-update setting on the device itself (Play Store > Settings > Auto-update apps).
device: dedicated test Android phone ONLY — never your personal phone
googleAccount: dedicated test Gmail account, created manually by the user (the AI cannot create Gmail accounts)
